step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified 8 nodes from the whiteboard: API Gateway, ELB, Fargate, RDS, Kinesis, two separate Lambda functions (one for event processing, one for queries), and DynamoDB.
2. Mapped visual connections: API Gateway routes write traffic through ELB to Fargate, which writes to RDS and streams events to Kinesis. Kinesis triggers Lambda to update DynamoDB. For queries, API Gateway routes directly to a second Lambda that reads from DynamoDB.
3. Ensured exact service string names matching prompt V9 schema rules.

graph.name: Temenos Banking Platform Architecture
graph.notes: CQRS architecture separating OLTP write traffic (Fargate/RDS) from read/query traffic (Lambda/DynamoDB) with event streaming via Kinesis.

nodes.name: Query Handler Lambda
